title: PRISM-AMC: Replay-Free Continual Learning for Automatic Modulation Classification
abstract: arXiv:2611.06066v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automatic modulation classification (AMC) is a key component of cognitive wireless systems, enabling spectrum awareness and adaptive communication. Most deep learning approaches to AMC assume a fixed set of modulation classes and access to previously observed training data. In practice, modulation classes and channel conditions may evolve over time, while storage or data-retention constraints may preclude replay of raw baseband I/Q samples. We propose PRISM-AMC, a replay-free continual learning framework that mitigates catastrophic forgetting by preserving task-relevant subspaces of intermediate representations via gradient projection memory. We further analyze projected stochastic-gradient updates under an SNR-dependent gradient-noise model. PRISM-AMC is evaluated in both class-incremental and domain-incremental settings. Experiments on the MIGOU and DeepSig 2018.01A datasets show substantially reduced forgetting relative to sequential

translated_title: PRISM-AMC：面向自动调制分类的无回放持续学习
translated_abstract: 自动调制分类（AMC）是认知无线系统的关键组成部分，能够实现频谱感知和自适应通信。大多数AMC的深度学习方法假设调制类别集合是固定的，并且可以访问之前观察到的训练数据。而在实际中，调制类别和信道条件可能随时间演变，同时存储或数据保留的限制可能使原始基带I/Q样本无法回放。我们提出了PRISM-AMC，这是一个无回放的持续学习框架，通过梯度投影记忆保留中间表示中与任务相关的子空间，从而缓解灾难性遗忘。我们进一步在信噪比（SNR）相关的梯度噪声模型下分析了投影随机梯度更新。PRISM-AMC在类增量学习和域增量学习两种设置下均进行了评估。在MIGOU和DeepSig 2018.01A数据集上的实验表明，相较于顺序训练，遗忘程度显著降低。
tldr: PRISM-AMC是一种无需数据回放的持续学习框架，通过梯度投影记忆保留任务相关的中间表示子空间，在类增量和域增量场景下有效缓解自动调制分类中的灾难性遗忘。
en_tdlr: PRISM-AMC is a replay-free continual learning framework that mitigates catastrophic forgetting in automatic modulation classification by preserving task-relevant subspaces of intermediate representations through gradient projection memory.
